slides.alt: A round dark rye loaf with a star-shaped scoring on a striped cloth, with the text: I've started baking more bread at home.
A bowl of dough resting under a checkered cloth on a patterned tablecloth, with the text: My sourdough starter is getting stronger by the day.
Nine shaped Kaiser roll dough knots on a baking tray lined with parchment, with the text: The Kaiser rolls my daughter loves need only good wheat flour and dry yeast.
Golden baked Kaiser rolls on parchment paper, with the text: They turn out delightfully crunchy and flavorful.
A round rye loaf and Kaiser rolls in a woven basket, with the text: It feels good to feed my family fresh bread at every breakfast.
A sliced rye and wheat loaf on a wooden board on a table, with the text: Still, this mixed rye and wheat bread is the one I enjoy with any meal.
The crumb of a cut rye and wheat loaf on a wooden board, with the text: Homemade bread is simply better for us than a store-bought loaf.
